description:
New director-swarm member that eagerly stages workshop-decision briefs for the new sync skill.

Files to create under scenarios/prompt-manager/store/teams/director-swarm/members/workshop-decision-prep/:
- heartbeat.json: cron '0 */3 * * *' (every 3 hours)
- HEARTBEAT.md: instructions + early-return-at-K pattern ported from portfolio-manager/HEARTBEAT.md
- RESPONSIBILITIES.md: scope statement (read-only prep; no side effects on backlog items)
- last-handoff.md: initialized empty with format header

Behavior:
1. Call `swarm-manager backlog pending-questions --source workshop --json` to get priority-ordered open workshop questions.
2. Early-return if last-handoff.md already holds ≥ 15 briefs whose content hashes still match current state (verify by recomputing SHA-256 of canonical-form topic+context+options JSON for each cached entry against fresh pending-questions output).
3. For top K (default 15, max 20) missing/stale questions, enrich each with:
   - Initiative summary (1–2 sentences pulled from initiative metadata)
   - Backlog-item summary (2–3 sentences from item description + workshop context)
   - 2–4 anticipated clarifying questions with pre-answered responses drawn from the item's workshop round and description
   - SHA-256 content hash
   - Any prior clarification thread's LatestImpact.ContextNote if present (feed-forward from async clarifications resolved since last run)
4. Group output in last-handoff.md by initiative → backlog item → decisions, narrative-ordered (not markdown-table-dumped).

Also register the new member in scenarios/prompt-manager/store/teams/director-swarm/TEAM.md.
name: workshop-decision-prep-agent
title: Create workshop-decision-prep director-swarm member
